question: If the measure of each interior angle of a regular polygon is 135°, then which one of the following is the number of lines of symmetry of the polygon?
explanation:
interior angle = ((n-2) × 180)/n.
  ((n-2) × 180)/n = 135, 
solving gives n = 8.

 A regular polygon has as many lines of symmetry as sides, so it has 8 lines of symmetry.

A sector of a circle of diameter 8 cm is formed by a central angle of 45°. What is the area of the sector?
explanation:
Radius r = 8/2 = 4 cm. 
Area of sector = (θ/360) × π r² =
 (45/360) × π × 16 = 
(1/8) × 16π = 
2π cm².
